name: Ryohin Keikaku Co., Ltd.
summary: Ryohin Keikaku Co., Ltd. engages in the retail of household goods, and food items in Japan and internationally. The company conducts programs regarding disaster prevention into daily life using familiar daily products and initiatives with developing countries; engages in video production, home sales, renewable energy business, and product development and production management.
